excerpt: Theorem 1: Let us consider the ith layer of an arbitrary n-qubit quantum circuit. The depth of the corresponding compiled quantum circuit, obtained through the data-qubit-swapping-based strategy, does not exceed n/4 dqs + dqs', where dqs = 3(cle + cbsm + ccx) and dqs' = cle + ccx.
overview: The theorem is the paper's central analytical artifact for the improved strategy. It claims a smaller asymptotic factor than the entanglement-only approach, while keeping hardware-dependent costs explicit and preserving a worst-case interpretation.
title: Data-Qubit Swapping Theorem
